metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the ridge, Gaunt said twice, a dispute at the tavern, and a few questions at the Bear.

yesterday: You rode seven hours, and in the afternoon you said Gaunt twice.
You heard two masters argue a comedy's ending, and you kept to the cup.
What you meant to say to Anne went out of your head on the dark miles. You were glad of it, and you said so.
A parcel is tied again. Tomorrow is the long wet day, and the bridge is the end of it if the day holds.
